label: LC/APC connector pair
notes: 0.25 dB is a typical loss for a mated LC/APC pair, not a figure taken from one datasheet. IEC 61753-1 grades random-mated single-mode connectors by attenuation: grade B is 0.12 dB mean and 0.25 dB max, grade C is 0.25 dB mean and 0.50 dB max, so this row's 0.25 dB typical and 0.5 dB ceiling are grade B typical / grade C max. Small-form-factor connector used in OLT line cards and ODF panels. The engine charges one connector per mating. Replace with the loss measured on the patch cords you buy.
